Build passes now: exit code 0, "0 errors."

Cause: `src/core/settings.js:17` used a bare `retries` variable that didn't exist (would throw `ReferenceError` at runtime), instead of reading `env.retries` from the passed-in config. Fixed by changing it to `env.retries`.

The 3 warnings (deprecated `crypto.createCipher`, unused export, circular import) are unrelated and non-blocking — didn't touch those unless you want them cleaned up too.
